The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. Contract Scope & Assignment 1.1 The successful Bidder (“Supplier”) shall not sub-let, transfer, assign or delegate the Contract or any pa rt thereof without the prior written consent of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli.

1.2 The Supplier is entirely responsible for the execution of the supply order in all respects — including sup ply, installation, testing and commissioning — strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of the t ender. 2. Breach & Risk of Non-Performance 2.1 If the Supplier fails to fulfil any of the terms or conditions of the tender or this Contract, such failure sh all be treated as a breach of contract. 2.2 In the event of such breach, the Medical Superintendent, Tirunelveli shall be entitled to make alternati ve arrangements at the Supplier’s risk and expense. 3. Product Life & Quality 3.1 All equipment must be brand new and of good quality, in full compliance with the specifications menti oned in the bid documents. Any equipment found to be of poor quality or refurbished shall be summarily r ejected, and the Supplier shall bear all transport costs of the rejected items. 4. Software & Upgrades 4.1 Where applicable, the Supplier shall provide software upgrades free of cost during the warranty and C MC (Comprehensive Maintenance Contract) periods. 5. Warranty & Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) 5.1 During the warranty period, no separate charges shall be payable for preventive maintenance visits, o r for any breakdown-call service rendered. 5.2 During the CMC period, the Supplier shall provide preventive maintenance (minimum 4 visits per annu m) and attend to any number of breakdown calls. 5.3 Charges for the CMC shall be payable on a yearly basis as per the quoted rate, after satisfactory compl etion of the relevant period and certification by the end user. 6. Delivery Location and Timings The Delivery Location is Main Stores, ESIC Hospital, Salai Street, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli – 627003. Delive ry Timings: Monday to Friday – 9:30 AM to 3:00 PM; Every Saturday – 9:30 AM to 12:00 NOON. 7. Force Majeure 7.1 The Supplier shall not be liable for forfeiture of its performance security, liquidated damages, or termin ation for default, if, and to the extent that, its delay or failure to perform its obligations under the Contract is the result of a Force Majeure event. 7.2 For the purposes of this clause, “Force Majeure” means an event beyond the control of the Supplier, w hich the Supplier could not reasonably have foreseen and which cannot be avoided or overcome through t he exercise of due care. Such events may include but are not limited to war, revolutions, fires, floods, epid emics, quarantine restrictions and freight embargoes. 7.3 If a Force Majeure situation arises, the Supplier shall promptly notify the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli in writing of such condition and the cause thereof. Unless otherwise directed by the M edical Superintendent, Tirunelveli in writing, the Supplier shall continue to perform its obligations under th e Contract as far as reasonably practicable, and shall seek all reasonable alternative means for performanc e not prevented by the Force Majeure event. . 28.
